svg.title: Molecule of the day: Cholesterol
svg.desc: A rotating 3D structure of Cholesterol while a graph neural network predicts its lipophilicity (logD) as 3.94.
svg.text: MW 386.7 · cLogP 7.39 · TPSA 20.2 · HBD 1 · HBA 1 · RotB 5
3-layer message-passing GNN · 4,200 molecules · held-out RMSE 0.603 (R² 0.731) · descriptors from RDKit
